verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI Atlas product lets users 'ask it anything about your sales tax and get an answer with the reasoning shown' (natural-language Q&A), and Headless Tax messaging references handing tax jobs 'to your agents,' suggesting some agentic/NL surface. However, there's no detailed documentation of a natural-language command interface for actually performing actions (filing, registration, transaction management), and the openapi/llms.txt probes show no machine-readable spec for agent integration. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of NL command execution (not just querying), evidence of agent/API action orchestration via natural language, independent corroboration.
